summary: Pulsenmore Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on July 1, 2026, announcing its Annual General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for August 6, 2026. The meeting includes routine items such as re-election of directors, approval of bonuses for executives, compensation policy, and reappointment of auditors. This is a standard procedural filing for a foreign private issuer, containing only a notice of meeting and proxy statement. There are no special situation elements like acquisitions, divestitures, or activist campaigns. The filing is purely administrative and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
